dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-thorax region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical inward curvature on the right lateral margin relative to the more uniform curvature of the left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity and minimal tonal variation across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, linear low-contrast marks (scratches) visible on the anterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle linear markings consistent with shallow rake marks or surface scratches on the anterior-dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-relief dorsal ridge casting a sharp longitudinal shadow along the midline of the posterior half.
